messages:
deploy-bot: Release blocked by parity-check: service="request-router" failed env/key parity between staging and prod. Key alias mismatch for keystore: prod=router/keystore, staging=router/keystore-v2. See run-id 8492.

maria: :eyes: dropping the diff here. staging helm values recently bumped by #PR-1187.

cheng: paste the minimal diff pls

maria: ```
# staging values.yaml snippet
env:
  ROUTER_KEY_ALIAS: router/keystore-v2
  KMS_KEY_RING: projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/rw-kr

# prod values.yaml (from release branch)
env:
  ROUTER_KEY_ALIAS: router/keystore
  KMS_KEY_RING: projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/rw-kr
```

sam-oncall: if prod is still pointing at router/keystore that means requests will hit the old alias -> decryption errors for tokens minted after the rename. We should not promote until we resolve. :lock:

lindsey: how urgent is the change? can we make staging fallback to old alias for the rollout window instead of changing prod?

cheng: fallback in code is a risky quick patch. The safer small blast radius is to create the prod alias pointing to the new version of the key material. ops can do that without a full deployment.

ops-bot: @lindsey @cheng I can open a keystore alias change request. Will need IAM approval and a short maintenance window (5 min). Request id: KEA-324.

maria: timeline? release is in the 10:00-11:00 change window, we have ~20m before start.

sam-oncall: if we wait for approval it might push the window. Alternative: pin the release image back to prev-minor tag (request-router:v1.3.4) and roll the keystore change in a follow-up. That gives us predictable rollback.

lindsey: agree with pin + hotpatch later. We should avoid touching prod keystores during the window if it triggers approval delays. Pinning is reversible.

cheng: ok. maria, can you create a quick roll spec to pin image and update release notes? I can draft the rollback playbook.

maria: creating roll spec now: ```yaml
release: request-router
action: promote
image: request-router:v1.3.4 # pin to last known-good
note: pin due to keystore alias parity mismatch between staging/prod
```

maria: @deploy-bot hold-release true -> adding hold label and notifying stakeholders.

deploy-bot: Release hold applied by maria. Reason: env-key-parity. Blocker id: RB-1745.

ops-bot: KEA-324 created but approval workflow ETA ~45m, will not fit current window.

sam-oncall: good call pinning. After window we can schedule alias migration in a controlled change with SRE oncall and infra.

lindsey: update release notes: "Hotfix: pin request-router due to staging/prod keystore alias mismatch; will follow up with keystore alias migration and a full rollout."

cheng: drafted rollback playbook (short): 1) pin image -> monitor error rate 2) if errors <0.5% after 5m, proceed to unhold 3) otherwise rollback to v1.3.3 and engage infra

maria: pinned in CI and updated release metadata. deploy-bot, status?

deploy-bot: Release flagged: hold=ACTIVE, image pinned=request-router:v1.3.4, affected envs=[prod,staging].

sam-oncall: can we still run internal smoke tests against staging with the v2 alias? we need to confirm behavior before later migration.

maria: running smoke suite now -> 6 tests running. will post summary in 5m.

(5m later)

maria: smoke: 6/6 green, latency normal, no crypto/decrypt errors observed on staging for pinned image.

lindsey: OK. scheduling KEA-324 for next-day change window with SRE and infra. Will create ticket and stakeholder invite.

cheng: thanks all. we'll keep the hold until alias migration completes and parity verified.

deploy-bot: Hold remains. Release will not promote until hold cleared.

maria: adding follow-up TODOs: assign owner for alias migration, confirm IAM approvals, add canary step in rollout plan.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-572 with scheduled window 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC, includes IAM approvers list.

sam-oncall: marking oncall handoff and noting playbook references.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen when KEA-324 complete or hold removed. :shipit:
